title: Clay Morph Icon
description: Khối vuông mềm nhún xuống lấy đà, bật nhảy theo parabol, vừa bay vừa xoay 90° và nặn dần thành hình tròn, chạm đất thì bẹp rồi nảy về; lần sau nhảy lại thành hình vuông.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-material-clay-icon-morph, written here): Soft square r27 on the floor (hops at 0.3 / 2.4 s). Wind-up squash scaleY 1 → 0.72 in 0.3 s power2.out (scaleX inverse); hop 0.66 s parabola, apex 62 px, stretch 1.14 at take-off (gone by 40 % of the air time); in the air it spins 90° and morphs square → circle (both power2.inOut; morph 0.36-0.92 s after the wind-up starts ≈ 9-94 % of the hop); landing squash 0.8, spring k320 d11 back to 1; shadow shrinks with height. Second hop morphs back. Params: windup (0.72, 0.3 s) · hop (0.66 s, cao 62 px) · stretch (1.14) · spin (90°) · land (0.8, k320 c11). It spins 90° in the air and turns from a square into a circle on the first hop, back on the second.
